# 1 Enoch Chapter 35 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**35:1** And after that I saw the other portals in the west at the ends of the great earth: three portals of heaven open there as in the case of the former portals of the north.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Ch. 35 is the briefest chapter of 1 Enoch — a single verse describing the western portals by comparison with the northern ones of ch. 34. The three-portal structure is apparently the same for west as for north. This chapter forms the western section of the four-directional portal sequence. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive, significant variants are noted.*
